subject.title: refactor(whatsapp): centralize inbound turn admission and history finalization

question: Should OpenClaw promote the turn-admission mapper and side-effect result through the experimental `channel-ingress-runtime` contract while landing this WhatsApp history-ownership refactor?
rationale: The implementation appears coherent, but expanding Plugin SDK surface and relocating message-history finalization are compatibility and delivery choices requiring explicit maintainer ownership.

options.title: Approve the shared runtime seam
options.body: Accept the additive SDK exports and land after exact-head checks confirm callback compatibility and every history-finalization mode.

options.title: Keep the mapper internal
options.body: Retain the prepared-turn migration but avoid expanding the Plugin SDK until another modern receive-path consumer needs the contract.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Keep the current WhatsApp adapter and history-finalization ownership until the broader channel migration direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared runtime seam
recommendation.body: Accept the additive SDK exports and land after exact-head checks confirm callback compatibility and every history-finalization mode.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the coordinated implementation and compatibility repair and can best explain the intended cross-boundary contract.
